verdict.rationale: cubic is a dedicated PR-review product with well-documented core capabilities matching the story: automatic PR review on open, local pre-push review of diffs via `cubic review`, PR 'tour' walkthroughs, fix-with-cubic actions, and an 'ultrareview' mode for risky changes, plus custom agents to enforce standards before merge. Community feedback is mixed (some praise contextual comments, others express generic skepticism about false-positive rates for this class of tool), which tempers confidence but doesn't concretely contradict cubic's documented diff-inspection/check features. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark of catch-rate/false-positive accuracy specific to cubic to corroborate vendor claims.
